title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

series.title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

fullText.simplified:
第十一章、投降

    262年冬天，诸葛亮死后的第二十八年，姜维再次北上。与魏军一场苦战后，姜维退回到了天水附近的一座小城。这时魏国的掌权者是司马昭，他发动几路大军攻打蜀国的都城。几个月之后，一个无月的夜晚，其中一路大军翻过危险的高山，攻破了蜀国的大门。他们没有遇到阻拦，都城内的蜀军无人反抗。皇帝刘禅为了活命，更是亲自打开了都城的大门，向这路大军的将军邓艾投降了。投降之后，刘禅派人送信给姜维，命令姜维也向魏国投降。
    姜维收到信，失望震惊道：“为什么没有死战，就先投降了？”但大势已去，蜀国都城和皇帝都已经是魏国的了，姜维做什么都来不及了。他失望极了，悲伤大哭。痛哭过后，他冷静下来，沉思半天后，想到了一个计策，这是救蜀国最后的办法。如果这个计策成功，蜀国就还不算灭国。如果这个计策失败，姜维就要跟着蜀国一起灭亡。他不怕死，也不怕别人怎么说，只要还有一点儿希望，他都愿意去做。
    首先，他听刘禅的话，向魏军投降了。但他投降的人不是邓艾，而是钟会。钟会是另一路魏军的大将军，既是魏国唯一有实力和邓艾对抗的将军，也是魏国掌权者司马昭从小到大的朋友，深得司马昭的信任。
    钟会是个文武双全的人，也是个有远见的人。他从小就听说过诸葛亮的事情，也早就知道姜维的故事。过去二十多年里姜维的那些北上战争中，钟会与他也有过交战。钟会对姜维是又“敬”又“爱”，“敬”是敬重姜维的品行，“爱”是爱惜姜维的才能。比起战场上的对手，钟会更愿意把姜维放在朋友的位置。因此，当听到姜维带军来投降时，钟会高兴极了，马上亲自出来迎接。他请姜维吃饭，与姜维喝酒，像老朋友一样和他聊天。他十分信任姜维，让他继续带军领兵。他对姜维的好不是假装的，而是真心希望自己能拥有姜维这个优秀的帮手。
    在成都的邓艾一直等着姜维来投降，没想到姜维去了钟会那里，邓艾十分生气。他认为是钟会抢走了姜维，所以姜维没有来投降自己。他和钟会的关系一直不好，所以现在更加讨厌钟会了。
fullText.traditional:
第十一章、投降

    262年冬天，諸葛亮死後的第二十八年，姜維再次北上。與魏軍一場苦戰後，姜維退回到了天水附近的一座小城。這時魏國的掌權者是司馬昭，他發動幾路大軍攻打蜀國的都城。幾個月之後，一個無月的夜晚，其中一路大軍翻過危險的高山，攻破了蜀國的大門。他們沒有遇到阻攔，都城內的蜀軍無人反抗。皇帝劉禪為了活命，更是親自打開了都城的大門，向這路大軍的將軍鄧艾投降了。投降之後，劉禪派人送信給姜維，命令姜維也向魏國投降。
    姜維收到信，失望震驚道：“為什麼沒有死戰，就先投降了？”但大勢已去，蜀國都城和皇帝都已經是魏國的了，姜維做什麼都來不及了。他失望極了，悲傷大哭。痛哭過後，他冷靜下來，沉思半天後，想到了一個計策，這是救蜀國最後的辦法。如果這個計策成功，蜀國就還不算滅國。如果這個計策失敗，姜維就要跟著蜀國一起滅亡。他不怕死，也不怕別人怎麼說，只要還有一點兒希望，他都願意去做。
    首先，他聽劉禪的話，向魏軍投降了。但他投降的人不是鄧艾，而是鍾會。鍾會是另一路魏軍的大將軍，既是魏國唯一有實力和鄧艾對抗的將軍，也是魏國掌權者司馬昭從小到大的朋友，深得司馬昭的信任。
    鍾會是個文武雙全的人，也是個有遠見的人。他從小就聽說過諸葛亮的事情，也早就知道姜維的故事。過去二十多年裡姜維的那些北上戰爭中，鍾會與他也有過交戰。鍾會對姜維是又“敬”又“愛”，“敬”是敬重姜維的品行，“愛”是愛惜姜維的才能。比起戰場上的對手，鍾會更願意把姜維放在朋友的位置。因此，當聽到姜維帶軍來投降時，鍾會高興極了，馬上親自出來迎接。他請姜維吃飯，與姜維喝酒，像老朋友一樣和他聊天。他十分信任姜維，讓他繼續帶軍領兵。他對姜維的好不是假裝的，而是真心希望自己能擁有姜維這個優秀的幫手。
    在成都的鄧艾一直等著姜維來投降，沒想到姜維去了鍾會那裡，鄧艾十分生氣。他認為是鍾會搶走了姜維，所以姜維沒有來投降自己。他和鍾會的關係一直不好，所以現在更加討厭鍾會了。

sentences.traditional: 在成都的鄧艾一直等著姜維來投降，
sentences.pinyin: zài chéng dū de dèng ài yì zhí děng zhe jiāng wéi lái tóu xiáng
sentences.english: In Chengdu, Deng Ai had been waiting for Jiang Wei to surrender to him, ..

sentences.simplified: 没想到姜维去了钟会那里，邓艾十分生气。
sentences.traditional: 沒想到姜維去了鍾會那裡，鄧艾十分生氣。
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào jiāng wéi qù le zhōng huì nà lǐ dèng ài shí fēn shēng qì
sentences.english: .. but to his surprise, Jiang Wei went to Zhong Hui instead, which made Deng Ai very angry.

sentences.simplified: 他认为是钟会抢走了姜维，所以姜维没有来投降自己。
sentences.traditional: 他認為是鍾會搶走了姜維，所以姜維沒有來投降自己。
sentences.pinyin: tā rèn wéi shì zhōng huì qiǎng zǒu le jiāng wéi suǒ yǐ jiāng wéi méi yǒu lái tóu xiáng zì jǐ
sentences.english: He believed that Zhong Hui had snatched Jiang Wei away, and this was the reason why Jiang Wei did not come to surrender to him.

sentences.simplified: 他和钟会的关系一直不好，所以现在更加讨厌钟会了。
sentences.traditional: 他和鍾會的關係一直不好，所以現在更加討厭鍾會了。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé zhōng huì de guān xi yì zhí bù hǎo suǒ yǐ xiàn zài gèng jiā tǎo yàn zhōng huì le
sentences.english: His relationship with Zhong Hui had always been poor, so now he disliked Zhong Hui even more.

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: Surrender
In the winter of 262, twenty-eight years after the death of Zhuge Liang, Jiang Wei marched north again.
After a hard-fought battle with the Wei army, Jiang Wei retreated to a small city near Tianshui.
At this time, the ruler of Wei was Sima Zhao, who launched several armies to attack the capital of Shu.
Several months later, on a moonless night, ..
.. one of the armies crossed the dangerous mountains and broke through the gates of the state of Shu.
They encountered no resistance, and within the capital, the Shu forces did not put up any opposition.
In order to save his life, Emperor Liu Shan personally opened the gates of the capital and surrendered to General Deng Ai of this army.
After surrendering, Liu Shan sent someone to deliver a letter to Jiang Wei, ordering Jiang Wei to also surrender to the state of Wei.
Jiang Wei received the letter and exclaimed in disappointment and shock, “Why did they surrender before even putting up a fight?”
But the situation was already lost. The capital of Shu and the emperor were already in the hands of Wei.
No matter what Jiang Wei did, it was too late.
He was extremely disappointed and cried with sorrow.
After weeping bitterly, he calmed down, and after pondering for a long time, he came up with a plan.
This was the last chance to save the state of Shu.
If the plan succeeded, the Shu state would not be considered lost.
If the plan failed, Jiang Wei would perish along with the state of Shu.
He was not afraid of death, nor did he care about what others might say.
As long as there was a glimmer of hope, he was willing to try.
First, he followed Liu Shan’s advice and surrendered to the Wei army.
But the person he surrendered to was not Deng Ai, but Zhong Hui.
Zhong Hui was the general of another Wei army.
He was the only general in the state of Wei with the strength to oppose Deng Ai, ..
.. and he was also a friend of Sima Zhao, the ruler of Wei, from childhood.
He was deeply trusted by Sima Zhao.
Zhong Hui was a man of both literary and martial talents, as well as a man with foresight.
He had heard about Zhuge Liang since he was a child and had long known the story of Jiang Wei.
In the past twenty years, during Jiang Wei’s northern campaigns, Zhong Hui had also fought against him.
Zhong Hui both “respected” and “cherished” Jiang Wei.
“Respect” was respect for Jiang Wei’s character, and “cherish” was cherishing Jiang Wei’s talents.
Rather than an opponent on the battlefield, Zhong Hui preferred to consider Jiang Wei as a friend.
Therefore, when he heard that Jiang Wei was coming to surrender with his army, ..
.. Zhong Hui was overjoyed and immediately went out to greet him personally.
He invited Jiang Wei to dinner, drank wine with Jiang Wei, and chatted with him like an old friend.
He trusted Jiang Wei greatly and allowed him to continue leading the army.
His kindness towards Jiang Wei was not an act; he genuinely hoped to have Jiang Wei as an excellent assistant.
In Chengdu, Deng Ai had been waiting for Jiang Wei to surrender to him, ..
.. but to his surprise, Jiang Wei went to Zhong Hui instead, which made Deng Ai very angry.
He believed that Zhong Hui had snatched Jiang Wei away, and this was the reason why Jiang Wei did not come to surrender to him.
His relationship with Zhong Hui had always been poor, so now he disliked Zhong Hui even more.
